evidence.reason: The test simultaneously makes `queue_start` fail (`rc: 1`) and replaces `jobs_before_mask` with the default/empty `_jobs()`, removing the waiting fixture. Its single assertion that `queued_setup_proven` is false therefore passes even if `build_checks` stops enforcing either individual requirement. Separate cases are needed to catch removal of either check. This is an ordinary test-coverage defect, not a requirement expansion.
